mapper.select: SELECT cart_item_id, user_id, mst_code, quantity, price_snapshot, added_at FROM en_cart_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY added_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO en_cart_item (cart_item_id, user_id, mst_code, quantity, price_snapshot) VALUES (#{cartItemId}, #{userId}, #{mstCode}, #{quantity}, #{priceSnapshot}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity), price_snapshot = VALUES(price_snapshot)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM en_cart_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND mst_code = #{mstCode}
